name: Digitraffic Road (Finnish traffic messages)
short: Current road works, accidents and traffic announcements on Finnish roads; free, keyless GeoJSON.
summary: Fintraffic's Digitraffic service publishes active traffic messages for Finnish roads as GeoJSON: road works, traffic announcements and restrictions, each with a type, release time, text in Finnish and other languages, and a location. Also available as DATEX II. No key is needed.

tasks: active road works on a Finnish road
location and text of a traffic message

pricing.notes: Terms of service page: open data under CC 4.0 BY. No fee or key is mentioned.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: the messages call returned 448 features; its dataUpdatedTime read 01:14Z that day, so the collection changes when a message is released or revised.

coverage.notes: Messages for the road network Fintraffic covers.

licensing.summary: Digitraffic terms: Fintraffic's open data is licensed under Creative Commons 4.0 BY, which allows distributing, remixing and commercial use with credit to the source; the notice and a link to the licence must be kept and changes indicated. AI training and resale are not mentioned.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

api.notes: Requests need an Accept-Encoding: gzip header; without it the server answers 406. DATEX II endpoints are listed on the docs page.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each message has releaseTime and versionTime from the agency; how they are set is not stated.

location.unknown: Message locations are road addresses and points entered by the agency.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.
